initiatives.name: Lexington Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: Neighbor-to-neighbor mutual aid network in Lexington, KY that matches people who need food, cash or goods with people who can give. Runs a needs/offers form and a Facebook group.

initiatives.name: PeaceCraft
initiatives.description: Nonprofit fair trade shop in Berea, KY, mostly volunteer-staffed, selling handcrafted goods, coffee and chocolate from artisans and farmers in dozens of countries.

initiatives.name: Lexington Tool Library
initiatives.description: A community-owned and controlled, pay-what-you-can library of things for making our homes and communities better.
